mainText: Good morning. Here is your market briefing for Tuesday, October 6th. Stock futures are higher. The Dow is up six tenths of a percent, about 317 points. The S and P 500 is up half a percent, and the Nasdaq 100 is up six to seven tenths of a percent. The 10-year Treasury yield is around 5.26 percent, down from yesterday's close. In premarket movers: P T C is up 36 percent on a 22 billion dollar buyout offer from Schneider Electric. Molson Coors is up nearly 10 percent. Constellation Energy is up about 6 percent. DraftKings is up 5 percent on a Bank of America upgrade. A M D is up about 2 percent after Citi raised its price target. Nvidia is up about 1 percent, nearing a 6 trillion dollar market cap. On the downside, InterDigital is down nearly 13 percent, and A G C O is down 7 percent. Memory chip stocks are weaker across the board.
